questions.q: Where does an admin define a new Custom Notification Type?
options: Setup → Notification Builder → Custom Notifications
Object Manager → Feed Tracking
Setup → Email-to-Case Settings
The Chatter Group creation screen
questions.explain: Custom Notification Types are created from Setup under Notification Builder → Custom Notifications.

questions.q: What happens immediately after an admin creates and saves a new Custom Notification Type?
options: It starts sending notifications automatically to all users
Nothing fires yet — it must be paired with a Send Custom Notification action in a Flow (or Process Builder) to actually send anything
It immediately deletes any existing custom notification types
It sends a test email to the admin who created it
questions.explain: Creating the type only defines its shape (name, API name, channels). A Flow or Process Builder action is what actually triggers and sends a notification using that type.

questions.q: What do the Desktop and Mobile checkboxes on a Custom Notification Type control?
options: Which users are allowed to create Flows
The record type the notification applies to
Which channels — in-browser desktop and/or the Salesforce mobile app push — the notification type can reach
Whether the notification is sent as an email instead
questions.explain: Supported Channels determines whether a notification type can appear on desktop, push to the mobile app, or both.

questions.q: What is the key practical difference between an Email Alert and a Custom Notification?
options: There is no difference; both terms describe the same Salesforce feature
Custom Notifications can only be created by developers writing Apex
Email Alerts are only available in Salesforce Classic
An Email Alert sends an actual email using a template; a Custom Notification populates the in-app bell and can push to mobile
questions.explain: Email Alerts (built on templates from Lesson 26) send real emails; Custom Notifications are a separate mechanism that surfaces in the bell icon and optionally as a mobile push.

questions.q: If a Custom Notification Type has only the Desktop channel enabled, what happens on a user's phone when it fires?
options: The user's phone rings automatically
Nothing appears there — it only shows up in the in-app bell, not as a mobile push
It still sends a push notification, just delayed by a few minutes
The Salesforce mobile app crashes
questions.explain: A notification type only reaches the channels it supports — without Mobile enabled, it shows up in the desktop/in-app bell but never as a phone push notification.
